paragraphs: CodeRight Inc. helps organizations modernize and automate business processes using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Office 365, and Azure. Custom application development sits alongside that Microsoft work. The customers it names are small to medium sized businesses planning and implementing technology from Microsoft.

The work is consulting shaped as detailed project plans, software implementation strategies, and support programs that follow a customer's existing practices. The stated aim is business software that is self sufficient and still running years later. The company says it favors the most appropriate technology, not the most expensive.

CodeRight Inc was founded in September 2007. Staff are described as people who constantly seek the latest software architecture and technology, then teach, write, and implement what they learn. The site says the company travels the world to bring businesses best practices in cloud based business solutions. Two customer testimonials appear on the about page, one attributed to a former COO of eXtremeCRM.
